fixed_dimensions.granularity: (head, position) pairs as Wang et al. specify them
fixed_dimensions.component_type: attention heads only; no MLPs, no layer norms

fixed_dimensions.direction: ablate the complement, measuring whether the circuit alone suffices

note: spread is attributable to ablation value alone; the other five dimensions of Miller et al.'s six-tuple are held at the values above
